en: I pulled the chair to the room.
I did not pull the rope quickly.

I pull the chair toward me.
I do not drag the table in anger.
Now you are pulling the rope hard.

You (f.) always drag the suitcase while traveling.

He drags the bag to the workshop.

en: He does not drag the dealer to the police.

en: She does not pull the bag quickly.

We do not pull the chair with the rope.

The boys drag the mat outside.

ar: هما ما كيجروش الكوردة مع بعضهم
en: They do not pull the rope together.

ar: انا ما غاديش نجر الكابل اليوم

ar: نتا ما غاديش تجر الصندوق بوحدك

ar: نتي غادي تجري الفاليزة ديالك دابا

ar: حنا ما غاديش نجرو الخشبة اليوم
